entities.name: Augustin Diamacoune Sénégal
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Father Augustin Diamacoune Senghor was a Catholic priest and a leading figure in the Casamance independence movement from Senegal. He served as director of the Saint-Louis of Ziguinchor Seminary from 1972 until 1975.
